title: Preserve every evidence-batch failure delta after stopped-worker persistence errors
outcome: Every changed observation publishes its factual failed-tracking delta at its distinct allocated revision when stopped-worker synchronous persistence fails; revision exhaustion does not reuse a revision.
acceptance: A regression with multiple changed observations, persist_worker_alive=false, a disconnected sender and failing synchronous storage asserts one distinct revision and failed-tracking update per observation.
Preserve the existing synchronous persistence attempt and normal batch/fence path; publish an advanced revision on write failure without emitting an old revision when allocation itself fails.

completion.summary: The failed observation save is now visible on the merged test-run card (failedObservationIds, plus the UI note "observation save failed (N)"). The batch and single-row regressions assert it per observation at distinct revisions. Landed in 6fce69dc (combo89) with a clean review pair and a FULL pass on DL560. Independent evaluation (delegation-8525e115) passed both criteria.
